images.scope: Historical food-preservation scene at Old Harbor (Nuniaq), an Alutiiq/Sugpiaq community on Kodiak Island. Placement is based on documented community/geography and locally explained naming history. It does not identify the ethnicity, name, status or descent of any person in the photograph, claim continuity of a pictured structure, or depict all Alutiiq communities. Old Harbor is an Alutiiq/Sugpiaq community. The archive preserves the historical label Aleut; Old Harbor Native Corporation explains that Alutiiq, Aleut and Sugpiaq are all names used locally. This image documents a historical place and activity, rather than identifying the individual pictured. Retain the archive's original Aleut wording as historical catalogue terminology. Do not describe the 1889 caption as necessarily an error, and do not reassign this Kodiak community image to the Unangan/Aleut profile solely from that term. The 3000x2449 Commons-hosted NARA reproduction was downloaded unchanged and visually inspected in the first pass.
